info.title: DemandIQ API
info.description: Backend for DemandIQ — demand forecasting and inventory management on Microsoft SQL Server. The request and response shapes follow docs/API_CONTRACT.md. Errors are `{"detail": {"code", "message", "fields"?}}`. Sign in with `POST /api/auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Sign in with a role, the current user, sign out. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other request.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: KPI cards per role, calculated with the global filters.

tags.name: Sales data
tags.description: Sales history, uploads of any layout (CSV, TSV, text, .xlsx) and cleaning.

tags.name: Forecasting
tags.description: Moving Average, Linear Regression and ARIMA runs, comparison, lineage and model recommendation.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Stock positions, adjustments, alerts, month-end snapshots and reorders.

tags.name: Administration
tags.description: Users, action permissions and screen access (Admin only).
